title: CustomReportType - Data API
description: A custom report type for Lightning Experience and Data 360 reports. This object is available in API version 68.0 and later.

Category.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Category.description: The category for the custom report type. Possible values are: accounts—Accounts & Contacts activities—Activities admin—Administrative Reports busop—Contracts and Orders calibration—WDC Calibration campaigns—Campaigns cases—Customer Support Reports commerce—Commerce Reports content—File and Content Reports data_cloud—Data 360 employee—Employees flow—Flows forecasts—Forecasts individual—Individuals leads—Leads opportunities—Opportunities other—Other Reports products—Price Books, Products and Assets quotes—Quotes semantic_model—Semantic Models territory—Territory Management territory2—Territory Management usage_entitlement—Usage Entitlements wdc—WDC

Description.description: The description for the custom report type.

DeveloperName.description: The unique name of the custom report type in the API.

MasterLabel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
MasterLabel.description: The label for the custom report type. This display value is the internal label that doesn't get translated.

NamespacePrefix.description: The namespace prefix that is associated with this custom report type.

OptionsFlagIsDeployed.description: Indicates whether the custom report type displays the IsDeployed option flag (true) or not (false).

OptionsFlagIsHidden.description: Indicates whether the custom report type displays the IsHidden option flag (true) or not (false).

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="CustomReportType">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="Category" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="Description" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="DeveloperName" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="IsDeleted" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="MasterLabel" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="NamespacePrefix" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="OptionsFlagIsAutoGenerated" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="OptionsFlagIsDeployed" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="OptionsFlagIsHidden" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
```
